Package net.sf.jguiraffe.examples.tutorial.model

Klasse FileData

java.lang.Object
net.sf.jguiraffe.examples.tutorial.model.FileData
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Comparable<FileData>
public class FileData extends Object implements Comparable<FileData>

A simple data class representing a file (or sub directory) in a directory.

Objects of this type are used by the model of the table control. Each instance represents one row in the table. An instance wraps a File object and provides bean-style get methods for it. (The API of File does not always conform to the Java Beans standard.)

    • FileData

      public FileData(String name, Object icon)
      Creates a new instance of FileData that does not represent a file. Objects of this type are used as placeholders if no real data is available, e.g. if data has to be loaded first.
      Parameter:
      name - the name to be displayed
      icon - an icon

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(FileData o)
      A special compareTo() implementation. Files are sorted alphabetically by their names. Directories are sorted before plain files.
